In addition to increasing costs at the gas pump, Trump’s war in Iran is expected to drive up home heating costs.

Utility prices have already soared over 10% under President Trump.

American families are paying higher energy costs for Trump’s war—and there’s no end in sight.

NVIDIA paid $20 billion for AI chip competitor Groq’s technology and hired many of their key employees—effectively acquiring Groq in all but name.

Before this deal, NVIDIA already controlled 90% of the chip market.

Is this deal an attempt to avoid antitrust scrutiny?

Six months ago, Trump and Republicans “defunded” Planned Parenthood.

Since then, thousands of Americans have been forced to forgo health care, including birth control, cancer screenings, wellness exams, and more.

We must fight back against Republican attacks on health care.

Donald Trump’s war with Iran is gearing up to become another forever war that burns billions of taxpayer dollars and makes life even more expensive for Americans at home.

This is a war that the American people do not want and did not ask for—but they’re footing the bill.

Affordable child care means parents are no longer forced to choose between raising their children and keeping their jobs. It means better outcomes for kids—and for all of us.

If we want to protect the American Dream, we begin with universal child care.

Trump has spent $12 billion on the illegal war in Iran.

That money could have:

Restored the Child Tax Credit for 1 year
Provided housing assistance for 1 million
Lowered drug costs for millions
Supported National Parks for 3+ years
Or paid 100,000+ teachers & nurses' salaries

Americans are paying more for electricity, groceries, and housing—all because Trump's policies have driven costs through the roof.

Now Trump’s illegal war with Iran is driving prices even higher.

That's not putting America first.

Multiple sources report that Trump’s Federal Reserve Chair nominee, Kevin Warsh, is included in the Epstein files.

It’s essential that the public fully understand the extent of any interactions or relationship he had with Jeffrey Epstein. I’m pushing for answers.

.@NYCMayor Mamdani and I have run the numbers: delivering on affordability means universal child care.

We’re in the fight to get it done.
usatoday.com/story/opinion/2…

Republicans in Congress know they’re in deep trouble for the midterms unless they can rig the rules.

Donald Trump even said that passing the “SAVE” Act will “guarantee the midterms.”

Don’t be fooled: the “SAVE” Act is their way to keep American citizens from voting.

Giant corporations, including Amazon and Microsoft, have earned record-breaking profits and gotten massive tax breaks from the Trump administration.

So why are they laying off thousands of workers? This looks like another example of unchecked corporate greed.
Reminder: Working families are losing the help they depend on to afford groceries and doctors' visits while Trump spends your tax dollars on an illegal war.

I’m proud to endorse @ZachWahls for the U.S. Senate in Iowa. Zach's got a bold and inspiring vision: ban congressional stock trading, raise the minimum wage, and make child care affordable. We need new leaders like him to make our economy work for working families.


Zach Wahls (@ZachWahls)

No one knows better than Senator @ewarren how to fight back against corporate monopolies, Wall Street Banks, and out-of-control billionaires. I’m proud to have her support for our campaign to take back Iowa,

Graham Platner's got the grit to fight for what’s right on behalf of Maine’s working families—not billionaires and giant corporations.

He’s inspired a grassroots movement to flip Maine, and I’m thrilled to endorse @grahamformaine for Senate.


Graham Platner for Senate (@grahamformaine)

🚨Endorsement Alert! 🚨 

“People are excited to vote for someone who will actually fight for them. Not just nibble around the edges.” 

Thank you, Senator Warren. Together I look forward to taking on Wall Street
